In 'The Ever-present Truth', the teaching opens with this observation: *"The root meditation themes]
Has anyone ever been ordained in the Buddha’s religion without having studied meditation?"* The central invitation is to turn one's investigation inward — to verify the Dhamma not as an external philosophy, but as directly observable reality in one's own body, speech, and mind.
